Start a new review with sensible defaults

Source: R/new_review.R
new_review.Rd

A one-step way to start: creates the project, registers you, and sets up the comparison you are interested in, so the first study can be entered right away. Everything can be refined later (in the app's Setup screen or by editing the files).

Usage

new_review(
  path,
  title,
  question = "",
  design = c("two_groups", "one_group", "blank"),
  groups = c("Cases", "Controls"),
  variable = NULL,
  unit = NULL,
  inclusion_criteria = character(0),
  exclusion_criteria = character(0),
  person_id,
  person_name,
  git = nzchar(Sys.which("git")),
  website = TRUE
)

Arguments

path

Folder to create.

title

Short title of the review.

question

The review question (a sentence or two).

design

"two_groups" (compare two groups, e.g. cases and controls: a standardized mean difference), "one_group" (describe one group: a pooled mean) or "blank".

groups

Names of the groups: two for "two_groups" (group of interest first), one for "one_group".

variable

Optional first outcome or measurement, e.g. "IL-6".

unit

Its unit, e.g. "pg/mL".

inclusion_criteria, exclusion_criteria

Character vectors.

person_id, person_name

You: a short id (e.g. initials) and your name.

git

Keep the project in Git (for sharing and history)? Defaults to TRUE when Git is installed.

website

Add the website templates? Defaults to TRUE.

Value

The project path, invisibly.

Examples

p <- new_review(file.path(tempdir(), "my-review"), "IL-6 in preeclampsia",
                "Is IL-6 higher in preeclampsia than in normotensive pregnancy?",
                groups = c("Preeclampsia", "Normotensive pregnancy"),
                variable = "IL-6", unit = "pg/mL",
                person_id = "ahj", person_name = "Anders", git = FALSE)
#> Created metawoRld project at /tmp/Rtmpn5cnev/my-review
read_analyses(p)[[1]]$compare
#> [1] "Preeclampsia"           "Normotensive pregnancy"
